author: Samsung
description:
This video captures how Bespoke AI makes parenting so much easier. From meal prep and laundry to cleaning and a gentle breeze that helps your baby sleep soundly, the smart routines of Bespoke AI appliances bring a newfound sense of ease to everyday childcare.
You might never want to go back to life before Bespoke AI.
The Bespoke AI Refrigerator with Family Hub cuts down meal prep time for your kids and smartly manages ingredients to keep them fresh. You can control your entire kitchen experience right from the 9-inch AI HOME screen.
The Bespoke AI Laundry Combo handles everything from washing to drying, tailored to the fabric, with just a single touch. The Bespoke AI Jet Bot Steam Ultra takes care of the cleaning with enhanced suction power and smarter object recognition.
Finally, the Bespoke AI WindFreePro maintains a perfectly comfortable temperature
without disturbing your children's deep sleep.
Rediscover your lost daily rhythm in the midst of parenting with Bespoke AI!
